description: Cancel a Company Search or Company Enrich task. Free. The task stops for good; you pay only for the companies it already delivered (a task cancelled before it starts costs nothing) and the rest of the reservation is returned. Companies delivered so far stay readable for 30 days. This cannot be undone.

task_id.description: task_id returned by company-search or company-enrich, example: '5b33f3ee-168b-4780-9c8e-63a626781872'. A People Search task_id is not found here.

name: company-search-cancel
title: Cancel Company Search
